name: Tantalus the Younger
domains: the inherited feud of the Pelopids

summary.text: Clytemnestra's first husband, killed with his newborn child by Agamemnon; his father was reported as Thyestes or Broteas.

story.text: Apollodorus calls him a son of Thyestes. Agamemnon killed Tantalus and his newborn child, then married the widowed Clytemnestra and took the Mycenaean throne.
Pausanias knew a grave at Argos for the Tantalus who married Clytemnestra before Agamemnon, but records two competing fathers for him: Thyestes or Broteas.
